inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, template, parser, recipe model, compile workflow, generated docs, and parser tests

anchors.why: Describes DevCookbook as an open source cookbook for developers and routes contributors to Template.md and the contribution guide.
Defines frontmatter fields and required sections for a contributed recipe.
Parses Markdown/frontmatter into a typed Recipe object by extracting H1, quote, Ingredients, and Directions.
Defines the Recipe dataclass and deterministic slug property.
Tests extraction of recipe name, quote, ingredients, and instructions from sample Markdown.
Builds generated docs from Markdown through Python compiler and auto-commits outputs.

known_limits: Auto-committing generated docs is risky for VAKS mainline and should not be copied directly.
Parser success proves format extraction, not evidence support.
The site is a playful cookbook, not a reviewed knowledge base.
